verdict.rationale: LiteLLM documents a self-hosted LLM Gateway (Proxy) with virtual keys and claims drop-in OpenAI compatibility. A maintainer confirmed the proxy handles streaming and function-calling the same way as the openai-python SDK, so it delivers the core of pointing OpenAI-style clients at the gateway. However, no evidence explicitly documents the migration as written, where existing OpenAI SDK code changes only base_url and api_key. The 'drop-in' claim is framed around swapping providers in the completion() interface rather than redirecting existing clients to the proxy endpoint. Missing for 10: explicit first-party docs showing OpenAI SDK code switched to the proxy by changing only base URL and key, documented coverage of which OpenAI endpoints are served, independent hands-on corroboration of an unmodified-code migration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible code at the gateway by changing only the base URL and key
